chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning's Auction War: Face, Fame, and a Five Elements Treasure
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning crashes the Treasure Competition Assembly, goading the Shaoyan clan into a bidding war for fame. A legendary five-colored Peacock feather set appears, promising immense power.
og_description: Ji Ning masterfully trolls his enemies in a public auction, turning wealth into fame and eyeing a legendary Five Elements treasure for his next breakthrough.
twitter_description: Ji Ning uses an auction to announce his presence in the capital, then sets his sights on a treasure made from the essence of a mythical Peacock.

lore_anchors.definition: The premier merchant consortium in the Grand Xia Dynasty, operating auction houses and treasure halls across major cities, including its headquarters in the imperial capital.
A concentrated, high-tier form of cosmic energy used as a currency for high-value trades and cultivation between powerful cultivators and clans.
A mythical sacred beast born from the Five Elemental forces of the universe; its pure-blooded form can manifest five tail feathers representing Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth.
A title given to the four most prominent and wealthy young cultivators in the Grand Xia imperial capital, of which Shaoyan Nong was one.
A tier of magic weaponry of immense power, typically associated with Celestial Immortals and above, requiring rare materials to forge.
A legendary top-tier divine ability created by Daofist Threelives, which uses the essence of the Five Elements to transform the cultivator's hands into ultimate weapons.
A treasure that is naturally born from and bonded to a cultivator or sacred beast's own body, usually linked to their soul and innate abilities.
